name: usage-log
description: Mod that logs skill use and the skill listing per prompt to local JSONL, for finding skills that should have fired and didn't. Ships usage-report, which summarizes this log and the bash-rules log.

retentionDays.title: Keep logs (days)
retentionDays.description: Usage log files older than this are deleted at session start, bash-rules' included.

promptText.title: Log prompt text
promptText.description: Record each prompt's text, with common secret shapes masked. Off: only its length and any /command. The judged routing report needs the text.
